title: 2-bed, 83 m², 2nd floor with lift and parking — Bas Agdal, Rabat
address_note: Advert says only 'Bas Agdal'; exact building unknown
surface_note: 83 m² per the advert, plus an 8 m² storage box and one parking space not counted here. Confirm on the title certificate.

area_price_per_m2.basis: Two sources disagree. Agenz's reference for Agdal apartments is 15,889 MAD/m² (blend of public data, adverts and partner transactions, updated 29 Jan 2026; Haut Agdal 21,235). Six comparable 2-bed adverts on Mubawab ask a median 25,573 (range 19,643–27,586); less the assumed 10% negotiation that is about 23,000. Mid = midpoint of the two, a placeholder until agents give sold prices.

offer.note: Target = mid evidence (19,450/m²). Walk-away ≈ 21,100/m², Agenz's level for the pricier Haut Agdal; the parking space and storage box justify going above mid, not above that.

furnishing_note: ASSUMPTION: about 1,200 MAD/m² to furnish and equip for letting. The advert does not say furniture is included. Get quotes.

str.adr_note: Three sources. (1) Your dashboard's Airbnb data (collected 20 Nov 2026): 50 established 2-bed entire homes within 1 km of central Agdal show a median one-night price of £79 ≈ 1,039 MAD (lower quartile 897, upper 1,155). (2) Airbnb's first page for a 3-night low-season midweek stay (9–12 Mar 2027): median ≈ 885 MAD a night after ~10% for the cleaning fee (720–1,015). (3) Mubawab holiday adverts for 85–90 m² 2-beds in Agdal: 649–799. One-night prices overstate what a host averages (fees, and only unbooked nights are shown), so base = 850, a little under the established median because a new listing has no reviews; bear 700; bull 1,000. AirROI Rabat 2-bed average: 1,052.
str.occupancy_note: AirROI Rabat, 12 months to Oct 2026: 2-bed average 38% (bear); top quarter of listings 62% (bull). Base = average + 10 points for an always-available, managed flat. Airbtics' Rabat median was 51%.

ltr.rent_note: 14 two-bed asking rents in Agdal on Mubawab (20 Nov 2026): 7,000–16,000, median 12,000; furnished 12,000–15,000, unfurnished or semi-furnished 7,000–8,000. This flat is smaller (83 m²) than most. Base assumes furnished, a little under the median.

flags.text: Title status not stated. Nothing else matters until the agent confirms a titre foncier and gives the title number.

With a 70% mortgage (25 years, 4.53% fixed plus VAT) the flat costs money every month in every scenario: base case −£345 as a short let, −£254 as a long let. With real costs it still loses £214 a month at the video's 70% occupancy.
Asking 22,892 MAD/m² is 44% above Agenz's reference for Agdal (15,889) though 10% below the median of comparable adverts. Sold-price evidence from agents is needed before offering.
Short-let licensing rules for private flats are unsettled nationally and likely to tighten; this building's rules are unknown. Treat the long let as the fallback.
Rabat short-let listings grew 68% in a year (AirROI). More competition ahead.
Service charge (syndic) not stated: estimated at 830 MAD a month. Building age not stated.
Furnishing budget (100,000 MAD) is an assumption.

verdict_reason: Pass. The video's own calculation shows +£647 a month, but with realistic occupancy and the costs it leaves out the flat loses about £345 a month on a 70% mortgage; even at the video's 70% occupancy it loses £214. It would pay for its own mortgage only at about 564,000 MAD or 1,876 MAD a night.
